concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-kakaopay-web-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15 KakaoPay Web Drop-in: existing Sessions/Advanced redirect flow, no extra base request parameters, but recurring token requests need shopper identity and storage fields; token creation follows settled initial payment/webhook, with separate TEST/live prerequisites.
warnings: Sessions v68+ requirement is explicit in that section; Advanced does not restate it.
Base-request 'no extra parameters' statements do not apply to recurring token creation or subsequent token-funded payments.
Shopper login, tokenization request and redirect are not proof of token webhook, settled payment or live enablement.
